name: Análisis de Sacadas
description: Analiza movimientos sacádicos oculares para detectar deepfakes
algorithm: Algoritmo de análisis Eye Saccade Analysis
mechanism:
This method analyzes saccadic eye movements for deepfake detection:

1. **Saccade Detección**: Saccades (rapid ballistic eye movements) are detected from the gaze direction temporal signal. Saccades are characterized by their amplitude (typical 1-40°), peak velocity (up to 500°/s), and duration (20-200ms).

2. **Main Sequence Verificación**: Saccades follow the "main sequence" — a fixed relationship between amplitude and peak velocity: V_peak ∝ √amplitude (Bahill et al., 1975). The method checks whether detected saccades conform to this physiological invariant. AI-generated eye movements may violate the main sequence — producing incorrect velocity-amplitude relationships.

3. **Saccade Dynamics Análisis**: Natural saccades have characteristic dynamics: rapid acceleration, smooth velocity profile with single peak, small post-saccadic oscillation. The method analyzes each saccade's kinematic profile. AI-generated saccades may show: multiple velocity peaks, incorrect acceleration/deceleration asymmetry, or missing post-saccadic ringing.

4. **Fixation - Saccade Patrón**: Natural gaze alternates between fixations (~200-400ms, stable gaze) and saccades (~20-80ms, rapid shifts). The method verifies this pattern — particularly the fixation duration distribution (approximately log-normal) and saccade rate (3-4 per second during reading/scanning). Deepfakes may show anomalous fixation-saccade patterns.

5. **Bilateral Saccade Coordination**: Both eyes execute saccades simultaneously (conjugate movements). The method checks saccade synchrony between eyes — independent AI generation of each eye may produce asynchronous or differently-sized saccades between left and right eyes.
parameters: Tipo de análisis: estadístico automático\nRango de puntuación: 0 (auténtico) a 100 (generado por IA)
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-85% de precisión según la calidad de entrada.
source: Basado en investigación revisada por pares en forense digital y detección de contenido IA.
useCase: Se utiliza como parte del pipeline de análisis multiseñal para detectar contenido generado por IA.
strengths: • Metodología respaldada por investigación\n• Tiempo de cálculo rápido\n• Complementario a otros métodos de detección
limitations: • La precisión varía con la calidad de entrada\n• Mejor utilizado en combinación con otros métodos
